create_Vector3d_message: create a Vector3d protobuf message with x, y, z double fields for 3D coordinates
create_Vector4d_message: create a Vector4d protobuf message with x, y, z, w double fields for quaternions
create_Vectord_message: create a Vectord protobuf message with a packed repeated double data array
create_Vector3f_message: create a Vector3f protobuf message with x, y, z float fields for 3D positions
create_Vectori_message: create a Vectori protobuf message with a packed repeated int64 data array
